title: Refactor PerformanceMonitor frame-rate tracking for concurrency safety
description: Remove Sendable closure capture warnings by moving mutable timer state into main-actor instance properties and removing dead variables.

title: Split DataService internally (Façade Pattern)
close_reason: Splitting DataService via Façade pattern proved too destabilizing for the dependency graph (caused cascading errors related to property initialization and protocol non-conformance due to SwiftData strict boundaries). Postponed.

title: Migrate legacy services from ObservableObject to @Observable
description: Align service layer with ADR-002/AGENTS strict MV guidance by replacing ObservableObject/@Published where feasible with @Observable and private(set) state.

title: Fix fatalError in initialization paths (KeyRotationManager, AuthenticationProtocols)
close_reason: Replaced fatalError with throwing initialization in KeyRotationManager and provided safe fallback implementations in AuthenticationProtocols

title: Restore macOS compatibility in GrowWiseFeature target
description: Address UIKit-only APIs and previews in shared views (UIColor, UIImagePickerController, TabView.page, CLAuthorizationStatus) so package builds cleanly for macOS target declared in Package.swift.

title: Standardize PhotoService to Swift 6 Concurrency (Fix mixed concurrency)
close_reason: Migrated PhotoService from GCD unstructured concurrency to structured Swift 6 concurrency (Task.detached) while maintaining UI safety.

title: Fix BackgroundTaskManager cross-platform build failures
description: Resolve macOS-unavailable BackgroundTasks API usage and compile errors in image transform path so GrowWiseServices builds on iOS and macOS.

title: Migrate view-local service construction to environment injection
description: Replace repeated per-view initialization of services (ReminderService, PhotoService, PlantDatabaseService, TutorialService) with environment-provided observable services consistent with ADR-002 strict MV.

title: Migrate Task { } in onAppear to .task { } modifier for proper cancellation
close_reason: Migrated unstructured Task creation and DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter to use proper state management, cancellation via .onDisappear, and native .task modifier

title: Fix N+1 SwiftData fetches blocking MainActor in DataService
close_reason: Fixed N+1 queries by replacing in-memory iteration in batchLoadPlantRelationships with BackgroundDataActor batchFetchPlants

title: Refactor @Query usage in Views to use DataService routines (fix over-fetching)
close_reason: Refactored JournalView and AddJournalEntryView to use DataService instead of @Query, preventing massive memory spikes

title: Clean up extraneous duplicate model files (* 2.swift)
Eliminate ReminderService optional-string and exhaustiveness warnings
description: Fix non-exhaustive switch and optional string interpolation warnings in ReminderService to reduce noise and avoid unsafe display output.

title: Resolve remaining strict-concurrency Sendable warnings in services
description: Eliminate Sendable closure capture warnings in AuditLogger/KeyRotationManager/SecureEnclaveKeyManager and non-Sendable error payloads.

title: Refactor oversized feature views into smaller components
description: Split very large SwiftUI files (MyGardenView, PlantDatabaseView, JournalEntryDetailView) into composable components to reduce compile-time/type-check pressure and improve maintainability.

title: Migrate from NavigationView to NavigationStack
close_reason: Migrated NavigationView to NavigationStack in GrowWiseFeature and used NavigationLink(value:) for strongly typed routing in MyGardenView and TutorialView
